KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

2. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   C. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

5. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.

6. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

7. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. mato

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Huyo na Hao and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Anga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
